peerGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (CCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

positions.label: Price position
positions.bandLabel: Higher relative price than most peers
positions.statement: Price position — Higher relative price than most peers: 7.1% above its local comparables; 102 of 144 similar developments with a figure have a lower relative price (a position, not a measure of value).

positions.label: Resale activity
positions.statement: Resale activity — Around peers (52.7): 3 resales per 100 homes a year (24 months): higher than 208 of 405 similar developments with a figure (the same as 11). Context, not scored: resales in 45.8% of months (24 months).

comparisonGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (CCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

profile.rule: Each line compares this development with its own comparison group; numbers from different groups are not comparable. There is no overall score.
profile.surroundingMarket: Surrounding market: other condo and EC developments within 2 km (straight line between development positions); new sales plus resales; subsales, cluster and other landed housing, HDB flats and this development are excluded. Competition, the quiet-area check and the Market backdrop use this same set.

lines.label: Entry price against comparable developments
lines.statement: 3-bedroom: median $4,775,000 ($2,366 psf, 1,700–2,303 sq ft; 7 resales, Jul 2024–Jun 2026); 8 comparable developments within 3 km: median $2,209 psf (range $2,000–2,818); 7.1% above; illustrative entry-price difference about $317,000 more. The entry-price difference is illustrative: the median price adjusted to the comparable median psf, for a similar-size unit. A premium or a discount is not in itself an advantage or a disadvantage.

lines.label: Sustained resale activity
lines.statement: No first resale wave in the observation period: sustained activity is the observed activity.

lines.label: MRT today
lines.statement: Holland Village MRT about 440 m, Commonwealth MRT about 820 m; closer than 254 of 551 similar developments (the same as 16). Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Primary schools
lines.statement: 0 within 1 km and 5 within 2 km; nearest New Town Primary School about 1,140 m; more than 0 of 551 similar developments (the same as 106). Straight-line distances. MOE measures distance for school admission differently.

lines.label: Everyday amenities
lines.statement: 4 supermarkets within 1 km (nearest about 410 m), more than 121 of 551 similar developments (the same as 48); nearest hawker centre Commonwealth Crescent Market about 330 m; nearest park Rail Corridor about 940 m. Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Future transport
lines.statement: Not yet assessed: needs official LTA evidence for planned stations.

lines.label: Recorded new-launch competition
lines.statement: 6 other condo developments sold new homes within 2 km (Skye at Holland, 666 new sales, about 840 m; Blossoms by the Park, 11 new sales, about 1,320 m; The Hill @One-North, 14 new sales, about 1,320 m; Bloomsbury Residences, 123 new sales, about 1,790 m; Penrith, 457 new sales, about 1,830 m; Hudson Place Residences, 226 new sales, about 1,900 m). Surrounding market, Oct 2025–Sep 2026: 86 other condo and EC developments within 2 km recorded 1,497 new sales and 396 resales (1,893 purchases); new sales were 79.1% of these purchases. Subsales (22) and this development’s own transactions are excluded. New sales as a share of local private purchases is a measure of market activity, not of supply pressure.

lines.label: Unsold inventory

missing.reason: not available until the URA-based launched-unsold measure (S3) passes the V1 local validation; no other inventory source is used

lines.statement: Not available: unsold inventory has not been validated.

lines.label: Known pipeline

missing.reason: known sites only; not a complete pipeline

lines.statement: No site within 2 km in the known list. Known sites only; not a complete pipeline.

lines.label: Quiet-area check
lines.statement: Quiet area: local resales are among the lowest 30% of similar developments, so little nearby competition reflects a thin market, not an advantage. 396 resales within 2 km in Oct 2025–Sep 2026, more than 78 of 551 similar developments.

lines.label: Market backdrop
lines.statement: Condo and EC resales within 2 km: 396 in Oct 2025–Sep 2026 against 441 in Oct 2024–Sep 2025 (−10.2%). Planning-area private resales −4.6%. Observed transactions, not a prediction.
